name: Fridge compressor
description: A sealed black compressor pulled from a fridge or air conditioner, with copper pipe stubs on top.
notes: A hermetic shell 160 mm across and 190 mm tall on a base plate with rubber grommets, three copper stubs and a terminal cover. The box counts the air in the corners left by the domed shell. The size is a placeholder.

name: Drive belt
description: A heavy rubber V-belt with steel cords inside, for an engine or a machine's pulleys.
notes: A 2 m belt lying on its side as a loop 640 mm across, 22 mm wide tapering to 13 mm, with a printed size code. The box counts the empty middle of the loop. It coils smaller in a pack, so the size is a placeholder for a folded belt.

name: Makeshift drive belt
description: Leather strapping joined into a loop and bound with cord. Fits an engine or machine pulley.
notes: A leather loop 860 mm long and 45 mm wide, its joint overlapped and bound with cotton cord, with a canvas patch bound on the other run. The box counts the empty middle of the loop. Found mainly as something a survivor made, so it spawns rarely. The size is a placeholder.

name: Air filter
description: A flat engine air filter: pleated paper in a plastic frame with a rubber sealing lip.
notes: A panel 240 by 170 mm and 40 mm deep with 27 paper pleats. The size is a placeholder.

name: Makeshift air filter
description: A cut-down plastic bottle stuffed with wadded paper, its neck taped onto a stub of hose.
notes: A bottle 110 mm across lying on its side, paper bulging from the open end, hose and tape at the neck. The box counts the round bottle's corners and the paper wads past the rim. plastic-frosted draws the bottle, so the paper inside shows in game. The size is a placeholder.

name: Oil filter
description: A spin-on steel filter can for an engine's oil or fuel, with a rubber gasket round its threaded base.
notes: A can 100 mm across and 150 mm long lying with its base plate to the front: gasket, threaded centre hole and six inlet holes, painted blue with a printed band. The name says oil filter because that is the common kind; it also stands for fuel and other liquid filters. The size is a placeholder.

name: Makeshift oil filter
description: A food tin packed with paper and sealed with a soldered lid, two copper hose nipples on top and tape round its middle.
notes: A tin 85 mm across and 110 mm tall with a solder bead round the lid, two barbed copper nipples, a tape band and a twist of wire. The size is a placeholder.

name: Five-point harness
description: Five webbing straps meeting at a round turn-release buckle, with steel tabs to bolt them into a vehicle.
notes: Laid out flat, 760 by 960 mm: two padded shoulder straps, two lap straps and a crotch strap, each with a slide adjuster and a bolt-in tab. The id uses an underscore because row ids are snake case. Laid out flat the box counts the air between the straps, so the size is a placeholder for a bundled harness. It is a vehicle part, not something a player wears.

name: Glow plug
description: A pencil-thin heater plug that screws into a diesel engine to help it start in the cold.
notes: 100 mm long and 14 mm across the hex: terminal stud and nut, plastic collar, hex, thread, shank and heater tip. The model is one plug, which really weighs about 20 g. Deadvox still has to decide whether this item is one plug or a box.

name: Industrial compressor
description: A twin-cylinder piston compressor pump on a cast-iron crankcase, with a heavy flywheel pulley to take a drive belt.
notes: A red crankcase on feet, two finned iron cylinders with alloy heads, a copper discharge pipe, intake filters and a spoked flywheel 300 mm across; 304 by 448 by 320 mm. The finned cylinders, flywheel and heads stand well apart. Its size is a placeholder for a thing too heavy to carry far.

name: Heavy-duty pipe
description: A short length of steel pipe with a very thick wall, threaded at both ends, made to hold high pressure.
notes: 400 mm long, 48 mm across with an 11 mm wall; one end open, the other under a red thread cap, with a yellow pressure-rating stripe. The size is a placeholder.

name: Heavy-duty pipe fittings
description: A loose set of thick forged steel pipe fittings: an elbow, a tee, an end cap, a coupling and a flange.
notes: Five fittings for 48 mm pipe spread over 360 by 240 mm. The box counts the gaps between the loose fittings. The size is a placeholder for the set gathered together.

name: Heavy-duty valve
description: A thick-walled gate valve with bolted flanges at each end and a red handwheel on top to open and close it.
notes: Flanged body 280 mm long with four bolts per flange, a swollen gate chamber, bonnet, rising stem and a spoked handwheel 150 mm across; 300 mm tall. The box counts the air round the flanges and handwheel. The size is a placeholder.

name: Large pressure vessel
description: A 3 m steel tank with rounded ends and a bolted manway, built to hold gas or liquid under heavy pressure.
notes: Horizontal, 3 m long and 600 mm across on two saddles, with elliptical heads, weld seams, a bolted manway, two flanged nozzles, a bottom drain, lifting lugs and a nameplate. At this weight it cannot be carried; it may suit a world object or a machine part better than an item. The size is a placeholder. Look with --size 512: the default iso tile renders it almost black.

name: Nitrogen membrane filter
description: A long steel tube packed with fine membrane fibres that pull nitrogen out of compressed air.
notes: 600 mm long and 64 mm across: stainless tube, alloy end caps, a brass inlet and outlet on the ends, a vent port near the outlet and a blue label band with a flow arrow. The box counts the air round a round tube and the end fittings. The size is a placeholder.
